entities.summary: Wasilków is a town in north-eastern Poland, in Białystok County, in Podlaskie Voivodeship, about 3 km (2 mi) north of Białystok, with 12 831 inhabitants (2024). It is a northern suburb of Białystok within the Białystok metropolitan area, situated on the Supraśl River.
